text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in Finnish papers this morning.
- Deportation of foreigners from Finland has increased due to rise in crimes, police say.
- Secret archive collected by the state police in late 1940s found in old Finnish Communist party files -- lists for example Finnish military personnel and their political stance. @
- Bank of Finland able to keep markka steady and appreciation pressures down until year-end, international economists say, but expect long-end interest rates to rise slightly.
- Stringent budget discipline and spending cuts in Nordic countries did not go to waste, moreover they have created favourable economic growth, says report by the Nordic ministers' council. @
- Finnish dairies do not expect fierce price competition to emerge despite split of cooperative Valio into independent dairies, sector representatives say.

- Common border control with Russia is out of question, but we can make border controls more effective, says President Ahtisaari -- rejects Russian President Boris Yeltsin's suggestion of joint operation while on visit to Yeltsin's summer cottage in Carelia.
